'''Aburrey Heavy Armor T1''' is a {{gear|4|Armor}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|A suit of novel protective armor modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
A combat model of the Aburrey Heavy Armor. When compared to the standard model, this suit features additional weapon connection ports highly compatible with flamethrowers, grenade launchers, and other ordnance.}}
